events.verdict: Williamson (NOP) moves laterally into LaVine's (SAC) path and initiates contact with LaVine's body that affects his SQBR.
Sabonis (SAC) is moving alongside Williamson's (NOP) path with vertical arms when marginal body contact occurs during Williamson's drive.

Sabonis (SAC) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact from Williamson (NOP), which causes his arms to come down. His left arm makes contact with the ball to begin the dislodge before the clean block by Murray (SAC).
After Missi (NOP) gets his left hand to the ball to dislodge it before he and Sabonis (SAC) mutually engage during the loose ball.
Alvarado (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Sabonis (SAC) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the pass.
Alvarado (NOP) swipes at the ball as he contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm.
Sabonis' (SAC) arms come down from a vertical position when contact occurs with Williamson's (NOP) upper body and head, altering his driving shot attempt.
Alvarado (NOP) swats at the ball as he contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm.
Monk (SAC) jumps from point A to point B and initiates illegal contact with McCollum (NOP) before blocking his driving shot attempt.
Alvarado (NOP) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs with LaVine's (SAC) arm as he releases the pass.
Missi (NOP) brings both hands forward, and marginal contact occurs when he grazes Monk's (SAC) arm as he releases the pass.
Murphy III (NOP) commits a take foul on Valanciunas (SAC).
Murray (SAC) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
